      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },

      "condition": "In case A, the new partner pays the premium directly and privately to the existing partners.",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []

    {
      "condition": "In case D, the existing partners’ capital accounts have been credited in their sacrificing ratio and they retain the amounts in the business.",
